sentences.en: Meanwhile, the foolish uncle was sitting in the living room.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，那个愚蠢的叔叔正坐在客厅里。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, I want to draw your attention to a point.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我想提醒你注意一点。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Jiang Qin distracted Jiang Feng's older brother Yan Daxia.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，江琴让江峰的大 brother 廖大夏分心了。
